objective: Correct PR95 feedback that asserted a new production gap while reserved or onboard rear-to-HQ cargo was omitted by the current projection.
source_findings: ArmySupplyView has available stock and HQ-forward commitments, but does not read rear manifests.
Dispatch.accept copies requested cargo before physical reservation or loading; requested quantity is not physical cargo.
Dispatch._reserve_cargo allocates actual claims/portions; successful carry/drop changes stock_items stages to Onboard.
Predeparture cancellation releases claims and physically unloads loaded goods. Departed cargo cannot be recalled by Dispatch.cancel; RearLogistics cancellation retains the real trip.
chosen_contract: Conservative omission is explicit: keep the existing available-stock gap arithmetic but label its branch Review rear deliveries. State that reserved/onboard rear-to-HQ cargo is not included and require checking physical shipments before extra production. Never claim a confirmed manufacture quantity from incomplete coverage facts.
acceptance: A short disconnected dispatch component distinguishes requested-but-absent ammunition, actually reserved stock, physically loaded cargo and the same hull after real departure.
With zero unreserved rear/HQ/forward stock while a real manifest carries ammunition, feedback must not assert that amount must be manufactured.
A request alone must not be credited as actual cargo or coverage; a rejected postdeparture cancel must preserve real onboard custody.
Preserve the old checker; revise its uncovered-branch expectation under this new reviewed contract and keep all original opening, custody, cancellation, receipt and later-cycle checks passing.
No gameplay owner, manifest/ledger read, world scan, recurring query, polling or physical/cancellation rule is added by the fix.
Both strict maps pass without pending purpose reviews.
authoritative_state: Existing Dispatch owns requested manifest and actual handling stages; Ledger owns physical claims and cargo; existing Army reader omits rear-manifest coverage and must explain that limit.
commands_events_timed_work: No new gameplay command, event or timed work. Only a pure feedback branch changes; the component uses existing manufacture, crew, fuel, dispatch, cancel and time APIs.
cancellation_replacement_failure: Do not infer incoming cargo from requests or infer loss from cancellation. Missing rear coverage remains unknown in this reader; current existing owners retain all custody and late/duplicate-work rules.
safeguards: Use explicit disconnected fixture grants only to arrange the component; do not claim an ordinary factory, military shortage or full supply cycle.
Preserve failure output against the old implementation, then execute the strengthened checks after code correction.
limits: No genuine need, new ordinary manufacture, whole delivery chain, return-to-duty, visible rendering, pacing or FPS acceptance. Lead technical and Designer exact-head review remain pending.

retained_unrelated_failure.result: Existing immediate cancellation during Dispatch Approach did not return after200 simulated seconds: manifest Cancelling, vehicle Dispatch Approach, holder vehicle-lane, empty task. No dispatch source change. Lead notified.
retained_unrelated_failure.revision_reason: The focused rear-cargo acceptance does not require cancellation during approach. Wait for the actual approach to finish before cancelling the request-only case, retain the defect, then inspect reserved/loaded/departed cargo and postdeparture cancellation refusal.
